content.title: Detroit Pistons vs Washington Wizards Live Stream: How to Watch NBA
content.text: The Detroit Pistons go for the 3-1 season series victory against the Washington Wizards on Thursday. The Detroit Pistons play the second of back-to-back games in the nation’s capital on Thursday night when they tip-off against the Washington Wizards. The Wizards are trying to end a 13-game losing streak, but it’s not going to help their cause that they are facing the top team in the Eastern Conference. The only team that has a longer active losing streak right now is the Indiana Pacers, who have lost 14 straight and are 1.5 games back of Washington in last place in the East. Washington is also trying to end a six-game home losing streak tonight. It also doesn’t help their cause that Detroit has largely bounced back from a season-high four-game losing streak by winning four of its last five games. That includes the Pistons’ last matchup on Tuesday when they beat the Wizards 130-117 to go up 2-1 in the season series. This is the last game of a three-game road trip for the Pistons, after which they will head home for four games. Detroit will be the huge favorite to win its 50th game of the season tonight and win this season series against Washington, 3-1. The Pistons victory against the Wizards on Tuesday didn’t come without a price, with All-Star Cade Cunningham exiting with a back injury. The Pistons star dove for a loose ball in the first quarter. He continued to play but was taken out at the 6:40 mark in the first, and he didn’t return. He is expected back on March 20 when the Pistons face the Golden State Warriors. Jalen Duren stepped up in Cunningham’s place to score a game-high 36 points and he added 12 rebounds. While the game was never really in doubt, Washington’s Bub Carrington still had a good game, leading the team with a season-high 30 points. Detroit led by as many as 22 points and there is little indication that this finale will be much different. What time is the Detroit vs Washington Game On?
